title: Plan a Proxmox host baseline check
summary: Prepare a check-mode plan for the explicit host package list; guests and access policy are outside this recipe.

target.description: Explicit target name from the private CmdMesh environment

expected_results: A static check-mode plan bound to this recipe, operation metadata and private inputs
No provider, Ansible, Terraform or infrastructure change runs during planning

known_failures.summary: The private target reference is missing or incorrect
next_checks: Inspect the private target, inventory limit and variables
recovery: Correct the private reference and prepare a new plan

known_failures.summary: A later approved package change needs recovery
next_checks: Inspect installed versions and the selected package/removal lists
recovery: Follow the recipe recovery procedure; changing desired selection does not uninstall or downgrade packages

provenance.qualification: Local manifest, plan and role syntax contracts
limitations: Host-only package scope; not the legacy host-and-guest baseline
A static plan does not prove remote access, package availability or workload health
